semiconductor_relevance: Medium — JNJ Tech specializes in electrostatic control solutions which are relevant for semiconductor manufacturing environments, particularly in cleanroom settings.
summary: JNJ Tech provides specialized electrostatic control solutions, including hybrid ionizers and measurement devices, aimed at mitigating electrostatic issues in various industrial applications. They also serve as the Korean distributor for Shishido Electrostatic, a company with a long history in electrostatic removal technology.
capabilities: Customer service and support for electrostatic solutions

regional_presence.Korea: JNJ Tech operates as a distributor and service provider for electrostatic control solutions in Korea.
